name: The Withered Hand

source.note: Cursed curio from the Drowned Crossroads; the book's numbers, our words.

magic.curse: Each Long Rest in which you used it, your Hit Point maximum drops by 1 for good. (Reference only; the game does not roll it yet.)

summary: A tattooed, desiccated hand that attunes on touch. +1 to spell attacks and spell save DCs; its Withering Grasp reaches 30 ft on magenta threads. Cursed: each Long Rest after use costs 1 maximum Hit Point for good (reference only).
